input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is the only assignment provision in the Agreement; it is a bare successors-and-assigns binding clause. It contains no consent requirement, no notice requirement and no restriction on HDI, so HDI could assign the hosting Agreement freely, including to one of our competitors. That fails the fallback on its material terms (other assignments requiring consent, consent not unreasonably withheld, notice on successor assignments). There is no change-of-control termination right anywhere (Section 4.1 gives each Party only a 90-day notice termination right), so that protection is not currently expressed and is confirmed by the added language. We have drafted to the preferred position because it protects our assignment freedom to affiliates and successors without imposing a new consent gate on us, while closing the gap on HDI-side assignment.

proposal.summary: Add assignment mechanics to Section 10.3: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors, HDI assignment only with our consent and never to a competitor, no HDI termination right on our change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only binds successors and assigns; it does not restrain HDI from assigning the Agreement, including to a competitor of ours. We have added our standard position: we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent and no change of control of ours gives HDI a termination right, while HDI may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may in no event assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
